title: Decode: DSA attention path (q path, sparse MLA, DCP value, indexer)
shape: D3-32 r24: 96 requests / DP rank (384 verify rows), L~135K, k=3 (per GPU: 24 of 96 heads, DCP4 KV shard)
basis: MEASURED in-step gap512 EP16 D3 B80/B92cap (baseline); MEASURED 1-GPU microbench at deployed rows (runs/D-ATTN/run1-3, qpath5); in-step A/B queued
gap_analysis: Baseline per DSA layer at B92 (368 rows, gap512 in-step): MlaQuery 89 us (side stream), QueryWait 46 us, trtllm-gen sparse MLA 32 us + LSE 1.3 us, DcpValue 25 us, paged_mqa_logits 35 us, DsaIndex 8.5 us; the indexer wq_b split-K on the main stream runs 62 us while MlaQuery holds the SMs. Microbench (1 GPU, cold L2): MlaQuery alone is cluster-round bound, linear in rows (33/52/72/93 us at R 128/256/384/512). LocalQuery (all 96 heads on every rank, no publish/QueryWait/re-arm) 29/31/37/44 us at the same rows: 2.0x at r24 before counting the removed publish + QueryWait; its cuBLAS q_b (18 us at R384, 1.2 PF) and W_UK bmm (13 us) are themselves 2-3x off SOL. trtllm-gen sparse MLA standalone 26/33/40/47 us at R 128-512 (model ach ~9.6 us at r24): neither HBM-bound (2.8 TB/s) nor MMA-bound (1.4 PF FP8); sharing 80% of keys across a request rows saves only 2 us, so the gap is the kernel structure (~20 us fixed + 0.055 us/row, 128 padded heads), not the per-row gather. Model note: P6 q publish (~17 us/layer at r24) is avoidable under SP by local recompute; the model q path should be min(publish, recompute). PROJECTED family after LocalQuery ~2.6 ms/step (q-path exposure -0.7 ms) pending the in-step A/B.
inefficiencies: MlaQuery: per-head 8-CTA cluster tiling, cluster-round bound (measured linear 0.18 us/row standalone) -> replaced by LocalQuery from 65 rows
P6 q publish + QueryWait cross-rank poll + DcpValue q-mailbox re-arm (R x 96 x 576 B sentinel stores/layer) -> removed on local rows
LocalQuery GEMMs: cuBLAS q_b N=18432 at 1.2 PF (R384) and W_UK bmm 13 us; untuned split-K q_b below 65 rows (D-GEMM tactic item)
Sparse MLA trtllm-gen: ~20 us fixed + 0.055 us/row, 128 padded heads; measured not BW/MMA bound (dedup alone does not help)
DcpValue proj: 25 us vs ~9 model (P7b push + W_UV + LSE merge)
Indexer logits: SM100 DeepGEMM paged logits runs the varlen next_n=1 form (one row per task), so a request 4 verify rows each stream its keys (L2 absorbs part: 2.2x model, not 4x)
rubin_features: tcgen05 UMMA (FP8 / block-scaled MXFP4) with TMEM accumulators
TMA gather4 for paged KV / index-key row gathers
NVLink multicast only where a push beats local recompute
plan: DONE: LocalQuery (wzhao/k31ws-d-attn 72fdf53350), unit test bitwise vs stock on cuBLAS rows
In-step A/B r8/r16/r24 (step_d dattn3 vs INFRA base-mx) -> landed-ready

Native 96-head FP8 sparse MLA decode (tcgen05, 2-CTA V split 2x256 with S shared via DSMEM, request-major tiles of 4 rows x 96 heads over the union of their keys, TMA gather4 of FP8 KV rows, trtllm-gen precision: E4M3 P at 448 x 2^(s-m), 128-key running-max steps, FP32 accumulate) target ~10 us at r24
Joint 4-row indexer logits: one CTA per (request, key block) with M = 4 rows x 32 heads = 128 (block-scaled MXFP4 UMMA), keys streamed once, weighted ReLU head-sum epilogue, BF16 logits as DeepGEMM
DcpValue: re-measure after the above; fuse W_UV into the sparse kernel epilogue (proj partials) + push
q path: a fused tcgen05 q_b -> W_UK -> FP8 kernel (no BF16 latent round trip; Triton tl.dot measured 1.8-3.7x slower on sm_107, dropped)
